items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The compact Task Detail and Mission surfaces implement the adopted FR changes without adding a second terminal, viewer, or Shiplog surface.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new network or persistence boundary was introduced; null artifact and inactive-detail states remain explicitly guarded.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Task titles and descriptions remain React-escaped, no HTML injection path or secret was added, and the terminal wire path is unchanged.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Behavioral unit and Playwright tests cover overlays, focus, compact navigation, Activity return, touch geometry, overflow, terminal DOM/WS preservation, and resize.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Compact panes remain mounted without extra polling, terminal resize work is cancellable and deduplicated, and no new data fetch loop was added.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New components follow existing external/mission conventions; new files are below 300 lines and grandfathered TaskDetailPage remains at its 673-line baseline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format, API contract, file-on-disk producer/consumer pair, or user-edited persistence boundary changed.
